title: Lattice-chem gated wall negative replicates on fresh seed 2: A pattern wavelength gate 12.0 px, no gate 13.3, slow-A twin 8.9; M rim/core 1.60 / 1.12 / 2.42; bath A unchanged (0.436-0.441); a connected labyrinth, not cells, in every arm
summary: Ran the finding's world.py with its three arms unchanged (phi_AW 0.5; gate gA 3; no gate; slow-A twin pA 0.06, no gate) on fresh seed 2, 128^2, 10000 steps, and its domain.py and ringwork.py. A pattern wavelength (structure factor): gate 12.0 px, no gate 13.3 px, slow A 8.9 px (finding: 11.5-11.9, 12.8-12.9, 9.0). labkit M rim/core: 1.60, 1.12, 2.42 (finding: 1.59-1.60, 1.10-1.14, 2.27-2.32). Bath A 0.436, 0.438, 0.441: the gate holds no more autocatalyst out of the bath. The A field is a connected labyrinth in all arms (gate/seed2/sheet.png), not discrete cells. The gate does a little; uniformly slower A does more.
